letters.evidence: Rightmost, A x~1110-1200 (line slopes; right end y~330-450): right vertical at x~1190 and base at y~445 clear in A; top bar faint. C (right strip, x~990-1050) shows a box open at left: top bar, right vertical, base. D murky. Top stroke weak in A, so ב/כ/ם cannot be separated firmly.

A x~1060-1095: one long vertical (x~1093, y~375-500, runs below the base of pos1) plus a thinner vertical at x~1060; the top of this area is covered by a dark corrosion lump/hole (also visible in B and C as a black blob). C shows one vertical under the blob. Either a single ו/ן or a two-legged letter (ח/ה) whose top is lost.

A x~870-1010: thick top bar, right vertical at x~1000, base at y~440 reaching right to the vertical; a long diagonal crack (x~985->940) cuts through it. C (x~735-840) and D (lower right) show the same box shape open on the left.

A x~720-820: a near-vertical left stroke (x~725) with two diagonals rising to the upper right, meeting it at the bottom. C (x~555-660) shows the same three-stroke form clearly. Same as the converging-arms shape seen elsewhere.

A x~650-700: a slanting downstroke from upper right to lower left with a thicker head at top. C (x~475-535) shows a near-horizontal top stroke sloping up to the right and a steep leg descending down-left from its right end. Could be a ר/ד with slanted leg; head length uncertain.

A x~525-610: top bar curving down into the right leg; left leg begins a little below the top bar (small gap). B (x~410-520) and C (x~350-425) both show top bar + two legs with the left leg not clearly joined at top. Gap is small, so ח remains possible.

A x~395-495: tall left vertical, base, right vertical, and a short stroke inside at the top right. B (x~297-402) and C (x~225-315) show the right arm turning inward (leftward) at the top and then up, i.e. an inward hook, not a closed top. So U-shape with inturned right arm.

Left of x~380 in A: a vertical crack with a round bulge (x~300-330), a vertical shadow strip (x~230-280) and a dark vertical at x~130. B shows a small hook at x~210-235 next to a crack. Cannot tell whether these are letters; no count possible.

P41.greek_or_numerals: None identified on the target line.
P41.image_quality: A (electrotype) most useful for the right and middle; C X-ray clearest for pos 4-7 (shin form, the he/het legs and the inward hook of the tet). B adds confirmation for pos 6-7 but its right half is damaged and blurred. D is low contrast and only confirms the box shapes of pos 3 and 7.
P41.notes: Target line slopes: left marker higher (A y~260) than right (A y~380), letters follow the slope. Corrosion hole above pos 2 in all images. Diagonal crack through pos 3. Strips B and C are offset horizontally by ~100-170 px relative to A. No space between letters clearly visible.

letters.evidence: A x~1185-1265 (right edge, y~230-335): a stroke descending from upper left to the bottom and turning right into a short foot (mirror-L). Its right side is at/over the image edge. B shows a diagonal at about this place but nothing more.

A x~1090-1150: top bar y~240, two legs (right leg longer), and from the foot of the left leg a horizontal runs left to x~1020 at y~350. If that foot belongs to this letter it is ת; if not, ח/ה. Left leg seems joined to the top (favours ח over ה). B: a base-like horizontal around x~1100-1260, y~360-380 and blurred dark forms; not independent confirmation.

A x~917-980, y~170-307: left near-vertical stroke with two diagonals coming from the upper right, the lower one meeting at the base; a large dark wedge to its right (x~980-1060) may be a shadow or an extension of its right arm. B (x~855-975) shows a vertical with a long diagonal meeting at the bottom.

A x~777-850: a vertical at x~830 (y~165-280) with a head stroke running left from its top (x~777-827). Height same as other letters (not a final). B has a vertical at about x~765 with a stroke at left, consistent but blurred.
A x~700-790, y~160-240: a faint short slanting stroke (and a weaker vertical at x~755). Could be a small letter or surface texture.

A x~600-700: two strong dark vertical creases running through all lines (folds/cracks of the sheet), and A x~340-500: a large flaked-off chip with no surface. B shows a dark blob (loss) here. No count possible.

A x~185-280, y~190-260: two heavy strokes converging downward into a V (left arm from x~190 down-right, right arm from x~280 down-left), a horizontal crack runs through at y~240. B gives nothing legible here.
A x~100-180 and x~300-340: faint small hook and faint verticals; not countable.

P56.image_quality: A was the only usable image; B (X-ray) is dominated by white creases, cracks and a dark loss and only faintly confirms pos 3-4. Overall poor: only pos 3-4 reach probable.
P56.notes: Target line slopes slightly (left marker y~230, right y~285 in A). Heavy vertical creases at A x~600-700 and a flake loss at x~340-500 split the line; there may be 2-4 letters lost there. A space after pos 5 is not visible but the gap is damaged.

letters.evidence: A x~1270-1350 at the right edge: a vertical at x~1275 (y~170-265), a heavy diagonal from (1310,230) down-left to (1287,317) and a thin diagonal from the same point down-right. Partly cut by the edge. B blurred here.
A x~1050-1215: top bar with rounded right corner, right vertical, base reaching right beyond the vertical. B shows the base line at about x~990-1130 (y~285-295).
A x~1000-1035: a dark vertical (y~160-330) along which a crack runs (crack then turns down-left). May be just the crack; B covered by a white crease here.
A x~800-905: right vertical at x~900, base at y~300-315, top bar only over the right half (x~850-900). Short top makes כ/נ possible.

A x~640-775: long left vertical (dark, extends above the line, probably partly a crack - B shows a through-crack here), base at y~307-320, right vertical x~773 whose top hooks inward to the left. Open top.
A x~510-600: an inverted-V/arch: two strokes meeting at a rounded top. B (x~440-540) shows an arch with two legs and an inner diagonal stroke. D shows a raised dome here. Inner diagonal unexplained.

A x~340-490: rounded top bar from x~385 to 460, heavy right leg x~455-490 down to the base, left leg x~340-370 with a second thin vertical just inside it (x~365-390). B (x~285-430) shows a clear rounded arch with two legs; D shows domes. Doubling of left leg could indicate two letters (narrow letter + ה).

A x~250-320: three thin, closely spaced verticals (x~255, ~290, ~315; y~170-260). Spacing (~30 px) is narrower than normal letters. B shows one faint vertical at ~x 200-210 (shifted). Possibly unit strokes of a numeral or parts of one letter.
A x~170-210: a dark diagonal hook-like mark (y~190-280). D shows a diagonal near x~140-200. Unclear.

P63.greek_or_numerals: Possible group of three thin vertical strokes at the left (A x~250-320) that could be numeral unit strokes; uncertain. Possibly a hook-like mark further left (x~170-210). No Greek letters seen.
P63.image_quality: A most useful for the right half (pos 2-5). B (X-ray) is better for the left half: it shows the arch shapes of pos 6-7 as clean outlines. D (two strips) confirms raised rounded tops at the left but is too low contrast for letter identity.
P63.notes: A long dark vertical at A x~650-665 corresponds to a through-crack visible in B (x~590-660); it merges with the left side of pos 5. A crack along pos 3. Horizontal offset between A and B about 50-70 px. Line is roughly level (markers y~220 both sides in A).

letters.evidence: A x~1095-1135 at the right edge: a dark rounded patch (y~190-260). B is washed out (white) at the right.

A x~920-1075: a short left arm (x~920-950, descending to the right), a tall middle vertical at x~990-1000 that starts much higher (y~90, maybe from the line above), and a bowl at the bottom curving right and up to x~1070, y~200. Three strokes converging at the base suggest ש, but the left arm may be a separate י and the tall stroke an ascender. B unreadable here.
A x~870-895: a long, slightly slanting vertical (y~190-320) descending below the base line of neighbouring letters, small head. B: covered by a white crease.
A x~740-850: left vertical, base y~260-275, right vertical with a curled, blob-ended inward hook at the top right. B (x~645-750) shows the same with a loop at top right.
A x~545-720: left arm starting with a small step/notch at the top (x~540-580), base y~275, right vertical with inward-curling top. B (x~470-585) shows a very clear loop-shaped inward curl and base.

A x~510-535: a short vertical (y~160-245); the step at x~540-580 may be its head or part of pos 5. B shows a top bar (x~415-485) with a vertical at its left end; consistent with a headed vertical letter but offset uncertain.
A x~450-495: a long straight diagonal descending from upper right to lower left below the base line (y~170-300). B has a similar long diagonal (x~330-365). Could be a stroke of pos 8.
A x~360-445: a vertical at x~415-440 (y~145-215) ending in a thick tail running down-left to x~360,y~275, with a short arm at its upper right. B blurred, a white diagonal near x~340-370.
A x~285-345: strokes (a vertical at x~305-320 and a diagonal) mostly in the band shared with the line above.

A x~160-290: a tall box (top bar y~70-85, legs down to y~275) spanning the target line and the line above, with an inner horizontal near y~190; probably upper-line letter overlying a target-line letter. B shows white creases here.

P92.image_quality: A is best overall; B (X-ray) is decisive only for the two tet-shaped letters (pos 4-5, clear inward loops) and partly for pos 6. Right end of B is washed out, left end has bright creases.
P92.notes: Target line markers at y~230 (left) and y~255 (right). Letters in the left third (x<450) are crowded against the line above and hard to separate; counts there are uncertain. Possible word break after pos 3 (descending ן-like stroke) but no clear space.
